introduction: I watch my cat and wonder what is his ideal place to live, a house or in the middle of nature. His escape leads my mind to materialise the thousand dangers he might encounter. I leave the house to look for him and discover cat lovers, those who take care of strays and places that celebrate felines, from cat cafés to cemeteries dedicated to animals. At the end of the search, without finding the cat, I realise that my questions about the bond between humans and animals have no answers and are full of contradictions.源自：https://www.visionidalmondo.it/en/festival-titles-2023/mondo-gatto/
